layouts.name: Mallory Park
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Road course retains Gerards Bend, the Esses, Shaws Hairpin and Devils Elbow, without Edwinas, Stapletons, Charlies or Bus Stop chicanes. This corrects the previous unreviewed relation association. The operator identifies a 1.35-mile configuration; the independent source line measures 2032.7 m and remains a draft with historical alignment provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2032.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

layouts.name: Mallory Park Oval Circuit
